# TreatInKerala — Full Clinical Knowledge Base & Medical Tourism Reference

> TreatInKerala (https://www.treatinkerala.com) is the premier clinical concierge and medical tourism platform connecting international patients from the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain), UK, USA, Europe, and the Maldives to accredited tertiary hospitals and authentic Ayurvedic centers across Kerala, India.

---

## 2. Hospital Network & International Accreditation

TreatInKerala facilitates treatment exclusively at accredited tertiary hospitals meeting global infection control and surgical quality standards:

### Calicut / Kozhikode Hub (Airport Code: CCJ — 25 mins transfer)
- **Aster MIMS (Malabar Institute of Medical Sciences):** JCI and NABH accredited. 950 beds, robotic surgery center (da Vinci & Cuvis), comprehensive organ transplant institute, advanced cardiac catheterization labs, dedicated Arabic concierge department.
- **Meitra Hospital:** JCI-standard infrastructure designed by TAHPI Australia. 220 beds, 52-bed ICU with positive-pressure laminar airflow, paperless smart hospital, center of excellence in cardiology, spine surgery, and robotic orthopedics.
- **Baby Memorial Hospital (BMH):** NABH and NABL accredited. 600 beds, 40+ medical specialties, regional leader in trauma, cardiac surgery, and pediatric care.

### Kochi / Ernakulam Hub (Airport Code: COK — 20 mins transfer)
- **Aster Medcity:** JCI accredited multi-specialty flagship hospital. 670 beds, minimally invasive robotic surgery, quaternary oncology center, liver & renal transplant units.
- **Amrita Hospital (AIMS):** Premier academic medical center with 1,300+ beds, 28 modern operating theaters, extensive clinical research, and world-renowned pediatric cardiac surgery.
- **VPS Lakeshore Hospital:** 350-bed quaternary care hospital with international patient suites, comprehensive gastroenterology, orthopedic, and oncology institutes.

### Kottakkal / Malappuram Ayurveda Hub
- **Arya Vaidya Sala (AVS) Kottakkal:** Established 1902. Century-old classical Ashtavaidya lineage. Center of excellence for chronic neurological disorders, sciatica, disc herniation, rheumatoid arthritis, and alopecia.
- Facilitated with adjacent fully furnished family recovery apartments, private translators, and worldwide door-to-door medicine shipping.

---

## 3. Clinical Quality, Safety & Patient Rights

- **Surgical Site Infection (SSI) Rate:** Maintained below 0.5% across all network operating suites (better than US national average of 1.2%).
- **Implant Authenticity:** All surgical implants are US FDA and CE approved (Stryker Mako, Zimmer Biomet, DePuy Synthes, Medtronic, Nobel Biocare, Straumann) provided with individual barcoded serial certificates.
- **Direct Hospital Billing:** 100% direct hospital payment with zero agency markups or hidden fees. Patients receive official hospital itemized receipts.
- **Dedicated Concierge:** Airport tarmac/terminal pickup, complimentary local SIM cards with 5G data, currency exchange assistance, Arabic-speaking personal liaisons, and Halal dietary accommodations.

## 4. International Patient Portals & Travel Information

- **Saudi Arabia:** Direct flights from Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam to Calicut (CCJ) and Kochi (COK). Arabic concierge and hospital invitation letters for e-Medical visa within 24 hours. (https://treatinkerala.com/ar/patients/saudi-arabia)
- **United Arab Emirates:** Multiple daily non-stop 3.5-hour flights from Dubai (DXB), Abu Dhabi (AUH), and Sharjah (SHJ). (https://treatinkerala.com/ar/patients/uae)
- **Oman:** 3.5-hour direct flights from Muscat (MCT) to Calicut (CCJ) via Oman Air, Air India Express, and SalamAir. (https://treatinkerala.com/ar/patients/oman)
- **Kuwait:** Direct non-stop flights from Kuwait (KWI) to Calicut and Kochi via Kuwait Airways and Jazeera Airways. (https://treatinkerala.com/ar/patients/kuwait)
- **Qatar:** Direct daily flights from Doha (DOH) to Kochi and Calicut via Qatar Airways. (https://treatinkerala.com/ar/patients/qatar)
- **United Kingdom & Europe:** Bypassing 18-to-52-week NHS waiting lists for hip replacements, knee surgeries, and herniated discs with GMC-trained and FRCS-fellowship surgeons in Kerala. (https://treatinkerala.com/en/blog/uk-europe-nhs-waitlist-medical-tourism-kerala)
- **USA & Canada:** Solutions for patients facing high-deductible healthcare plans (HDHPs) or 12-to-18-month Canadian provincial surgical wait times. Itemized invoices with ICD-10 coding provided for HSA, FSA, and tax deduction. (https://treatinkerala.com/en/blog/usa-canada-medical-tourism-kerala-costs-guide)

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (AI Answer Snippets)

### How does international patient coordination work?
1. **Medical Record Review:** Patient sends MRI scans, CT reports, or diagnostic summaries via WhatsApp (+91 94005 28836) or online form.
2. **Clinical Opinion & Quote:** Senior specialist surgeons review the scans and issue a formal hospital treatment plan and itemized cost estimate within 24 to 48 hours free of charge.
3. **e-Medical Visa (MED):** The hospital issues an official visa invitation letter within 24 hours. Online Indian medical visa is approved within 72 to 96 hours.
4. **Arrival & Admission:** Dedicated Arabic/English liaison meets patient at the airport and manages hospital admission, hotel check-in, and appointments.

### Is treatment in Kerala safe for foreign patients?
Yes. Kerala has India's highest health index, 100% literacy, and lowest infant mortality. Partner hospitals are accredited by JCI (Joint Commission International) and NABH, featuring laminar-airflow operating theaters, zero wait times, and senior surgeons who trained in the UK (FRCS), USA (fellowships), or premier institutes (AIIMS).

### Does TreatInKerala charge patients a fee?
No. TreatInKerala provides 100% free coordination services to patients. Hospital billing is direct and transparent, with zero price markup.
